elements_selected.content: Create themes/default/_graph.html: single-Sigma-instance partial. Instantiates graphology DirectedGraph (from inline graph_index or fetched graph_index_url), runs graphology-layout-forceatlas2 in a Web Worker when available, mounts Sigma.js v3. Implements mode switching (local/vault/off) via data-mode attribute. nodeReducer/edgeReducer read CSS custom properties via getComputedStyle.
